summary: Video hosting for the Built with Claude Code series (Shorts, Reels, Stories) · Built with Claude Code serisinin kısa videoları için barındırma
key_features: Short videos of the Built with Claude Code series for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Stories, and X
Video files live in GitHub Releases, one release per batch of episodes, so the scheduler gets stable public download URLs
The voiceover is AI-generated (Google Gemini TTS for the game promos, Supertonic 3 for the older episodes) and says so in the README and every post; the videos are made with Remotion

social.headline: Where the Built with Claude Code short videos are hosted, one release per batch of episodes.
